### **Diagonal Persistence in Persistent Homology**
Persistent homology studies the evolution of topological features (e.g., connected components, holes) across a filtration (e.g., growing simplicial complexes). **Diagonal persistence** focuses on features aligned with the diagonal in persistence dia
